import re

def extract_grid(text, label):
 lines=text.splitlines()
 idx=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith(label))
 rows=[]
 for l in lines[idx+1:idx+31]:
  vals=[int(x) for x in l.split()]
  if len(vals)!=30: raise ValueError((label,l,len(vals)))
  rows.append(vals)
 assert len(rows)==30
 return rows

def transform(grid):
 return [[grid[j][i] if grid[i][j] == 6 else grid[i][j] for j in range(30)] for i in range(30)]

pairs=[]
for k,text in enumerate(user_texts[1:],1):
 inp=extract_grid(text, f'Demo pair {k} input')
 out=extract_grid(text, f'Demo pair {k} output')
 pred=transform(inp)
 diffs=[(i,j,pred[i][j],out[i][j]) for i in range(30) for j in range(30) if pred[i][j]!=out[i][j]]
 print(k, 'masks',sum(v==6 for row in inp for v in row),'mismatches',len(diffs),diffs[:10])
 pairs.append((inp,out))
test=extract_grid(user_texts[0], 'Test input (30x30)')
ans=transform(test)
print('test masks',sum(v==6 for row in test for v in row),'masked without source',[(i,j) for i in range(30) for j in range(30) if test[i][j]==6 and test[j][i]==6][:10])
